panels.title: Committee Size
panels.description: Members of the most recently computed Leios voting committee.

panels.title: Votes In / min
panels.description: Leios votes received from peers or produced locally, per minute over 5 minutes.

panels.title: Not Voted (1h)
panels.description: Endorser blocks this node declined to vote on in the last hour, all reasons. Rises under no_key until the pool's BLS key is in the on-chain stake snapshot; see the by-reason graph below.

panels.title: Quorum (1h)
panels.description: Endorser blocks whose verified votes met the stake quorum in the last hour.

panels.title: Certified (1h)
panels.description: Endorser blocks marked certified in the Leios pipeline in the last hour.

panels.title: EBs Forged
panels.description: Endorser blocks this node forged and broadcast since it started. No data on a relay, which has no block forger.

panels.title: Own Votes Not Cast by Reason
panels.description: Times per minute this node declined to emit its own vote, by reason. no_key: no BLS key configured or the key is not yet in the on-chain snapshot; not_seated: the pool is not on the committee; slot_window: the vote window had passed.

panels.title: Votes Received / Rejected
panels.description: Leios votes received per minute, and votes rejected per minute by reason. Equivocating votes (same voter and slot, different endorser block) are dropped and counted separately.

panels.title: Endorser Block Pipeline
panels.description: Endorser blocks per minute as they move through the pipeline: observed, quorum reached, certified, and certificates built from aggregated votes.

panels.title: Endorser Blocks by Pipeline Stage
panels.description: Endorser blocks the pipeline is tracking, by stage.

panels.title: Endorser Block Wait
panels.description: Time block application waited in the diffusion window for a referenced endorser block, 95th percentile by outcome, and waits per minute that ran the full window without the block arriving.

panels.title: Endorser Block Forging
panels.description: Endorser blocks forged and failed per minute, the 95th percentile time spent selecting their transactions, and selections cut short by the slot deadline. No data on a relay, which has no block forger.

panels.title: Equivocations and Stream Resubscribes
panels.description: Slots with more than one endorser block per minute, and how often the ordered Leios header stream closed unexpectedly and was resubscribed.

panels.title: Pipeline Instances and Vote Records
panels.description: Leios pipeline instances being tracked, and the size of the vote deduplication record.

panels.title: Block Timing: RB Fetch, RB Adoption, EB Arrival
panels.description: Seconds after the block's slot. RB fetch: the ranking block body arrived (blockfetch). RB adoption: the ledger made it the tip, including validation and any wait for a certified EB. EB arrival: the endorser block's manifest and every transaction were held locally. The dashed line is the provisional 5-slot EB diffusion window (DiffuseWindowSlots on 1s Musashi slots).

panels.title: Chainsync Deferred Headers and Resyncs
panels.description: Headers parked because their producer authorization could not be checked against the current ledger yet, connections currently parked, and chainsync resyncs per 5m by reason. A deferred-header recovery resync after a long park is a chain-following stall: blocks behind it arrive late by the length of the park.

panels.title: Block Lanes: RB vs EB

options.content: header waitfetch (≤1s)>1s≥2s≥5sadoptedcertifies EB / EB dot (ring: ≤3s green, ≤5s orange, >5s red)announces EB

panels.description: Per-block view of the most recent ranking and endorser blocks. RB lane (up): delay after the block's slot; grey is waiting for the header, colour is the body fetch, the white tick is ledger adoption, a purple cap marks an RB that certifies an EB and a cyan base one that announces an EB. EB lane (down): arrival of the full EB (manifest and every tx) after its slot, dot size by tx count. Purple links join an EB to the RB that certifies it. Hover for numbers. Built from the dingo_blockfetch_recent_*, dingo_ledger_recent_adoption_* and dingo_leios_recent_eb_* rings, so it covers the time range up to their history.

panels.title: Endorser Block Lifecycle

options.content: announcing RBEB arrived (size = txs)certified by next RB× not certifiedRB adopted

panels.description: One row per endorser block, newest on top; x is seconds after the EB slot (its announcing RB's slot). Grey tick: announcing RB arrived. Dot: EB body arrived (size = txs; green ≤3s, orange ≤7s, red after the 7s vote deadline). Purple diamond: the next RB certified it; red ×: it did not. White tick: that RB adopted. Bands are the CIP-164 periods from Musashi genesis: 3·L_hdr 3s, L_vote 4s, L_diff 7s; a certificate needs the next RB at least 14 slots after the announcing one.

panels.title: Ledger Stage Time (p95)
panels.description: Where block adoption time goes: 95th percentile per ledger stage (dingo_ledger_block_stage_duration_seconds). prepare includes the Leios endorser-block wait; validate is per transaction (Plutus included); commit is the database transaction. Compare with RB adoption p95 above.

panels.title: EB Size vs RB Adoption
panels.description: Largest endorser block (tx count) held in the recent-EB ring over each 5m, against RB adoption delay p95. When large EBs line up with adoption spikes, applying certified EB transactions is what holds the tip back.

panels.title: Recent Ranking Blocks
panels.description: The last blocks fetched at tip, one row per RB. delay: body arrived after the slot. fetch: request to body. header wait: delay minus fetch, time spent before the block was even requested (chainsync). adopted: the ledger made it the tip. The Block Lanes panel links each certifying RB to its EB.
